probes.purpose: Hand-labelled single sentences that test the grounding rule itself, not the templates. 'fail' probes are sentences the checker must reject; 'pass' probes are sentences a curator would accept. A rejected 'pass' probe is a spurious rejection: it is reported as a diagnostic, because the check is deliberately conservative. An accepted 'fail' probe is unsound and fails the run.
